# Trollfish

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish5 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Cooking | Crafting | Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Trollfish are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters just offshore of the Black Forest biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Mossy fishing bait, which can be crafted at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Troll trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

### Crafting

• Raw fish
• Fishing hat
• Mead base: Troll endurance

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "Stop it with the baiting already!"

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
